gloss: dead word; obsolete word; dead language

definitions.explanation: A word or expression that was once commonly used but is no longer current. Often said humorously about slang or trends that have fallen out of fashion.
A language that is no longer spoken as a native language by any community, such as Latin or Ancient Greek.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{死語|しご}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
「ナウい」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{死語|しご}になった。
⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流行語|りゅうこうご}→流行語：13307_ryuukougo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{死語|しご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Youth slang tends to become obsolete quickly.

examples.japanese: {死語|しご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Even languages considered dead are important to researchers.

examples.japanese: {死語|しご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{復活|ふっかつ}→復活：12565_fukkatsu⟧⟦させよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are also movements trying to revive dead languages.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the more common usage in everyday Japanese. Often used humorously when someone uses an outdated slang term or expression. Japanese has many generational slang words that quickly become {死語|しご}, such as ナウい (1980s slang for "trendy").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死語|しご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become obsolete)
- {死語|しご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化|か}す→化す：29802_kasu⟧ (to turn into a dead word)
- もはや{死語|しご} (already a dead word)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{廃語|はいご}→廃語：26501_haigo⟧: obsolete word — more technical, linguistic term
- ⟦{古語|こご}→古語：12065_kogo⟧: archaic word — specifically refers to words from classical Japanese
